title: ring-1.io bootloader implant deobfuscation
summary: Aftermath Labs published a repository accompanying its deep dive on the ring-1.io cheat platform, including a partially deobfuscated loader, a deobfuscated UEFI bootloader implant with an IDA database, a modified bootmgfw image, and game cheat modules it dissected. The material is published for defensive research and credits named contributors by role.
